data.name: Dungeoncraft
data.detailed_description:
Dungeoncraft is a fantasy real-time strategy game where your orders only travel as far as your voice. Your avatar commands the units nearby, and those units pass orders on to others. Anyone outside that chain keeps doing what you last told them, so for the rest you write orders down and send them by hand.

Build, fight and keep your people fed and rested while goblins raid you.

data.short_description: Command a small company by voice. Orders cost actions and only carry so far, relaying unit to unit; past that you write them down and send them by hand. Isometric fantasy strategy with survival, building, and a campaign in progress.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core x86-64, 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 / Vulkan capable GPU, 2 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows-compatible audio device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: 6-core x86-64, 3.5 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Discrete GPU with 4 GB VRAM or more
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any Windows-compatible audio device

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS or a comparably current distribution
  • Processor: Quad-core x86-64, 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan-capable GPU, 2 GB VRAM (Mesa or NVIDIA proprietary)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA-compatible audio device
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit only. Runs on X11; on Wayland sessions it runs via XWayland. Online play runs through Steam networking.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS or newer
  • Processor: 6-core x86-64, 3.5 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Discrete GPU with 4 GB VRAM or more
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA-compatible audio device
